title: Bruisers 2D Boxing
description:
Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Don’t let the pixel art fool you, because the boxing is real: slip, counter, move your head, control distance, break your opponent down. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up. Tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal.

Build your fighter from scratch and take them as far as you can. Plan your meals, make weight, watch your vitals, hold down a job between fights. Stock your corner and work your way through the amateur, professional, and bareknuckle circuits.

Your boxer ages in real time. The years wear on you. So do the injuries, as damage accumulates. A career full of hard fights will show. Every decision compounds. A bad camp, a missed weight cut, the wrong fight at the wrong time: it all matters and it all adds up. Rivalries develop along the way, and some of them get personal.

Outside the ring, the world has its own rules. Your career might not go where you expect: every playthrough tells a different story. Shady dealings, illegal gambling, a mob presence that lurks just below the surface. Need an edge? There are “options” if you know where to look.

Blood. Stoppages. Knockouts. Some referees stop the fight. Others don’t. Backyard shows, dingy gyms, smoky clubs, and packed arenas. Every fight has a life of its own.

Need to settle a beef with a friend? Pull up a seat on the couch and jump into quick play with 100+ fighters inspired by real boxing history. Winner takes all.

FEATURES

Jabs, straights, hooks, uppercuts, and overhands — choose your punch selection and make it count. Master timing, counters, slipping punches, head movement, and parrying to edge the upper hand, in boxing that's built to feel real, not scripted. Your stance shifts to in-fighting the moment you get up close and personal with your opponent. Slick, Bully, or Balanced: three distinct boxing styles, each with its own strengths, weaknesses, and way of winning a fight. Learn yours, or get exposed. Tie up your opponent and deliver punches in the clinch to wear them down, before the referee steps in.

Start from nothing and climb from amateur to pro through training, wins, and tough choices, with every step feeding a career that actually grows with you. Or drop into the underground bareknuckle leagues instead.

Balance workouts, job shifts, and nutrition to stay healthy, level up, and make money to fund your needs between fights. Train, eat, survive, in that order.

Push too hard and you'll pay for it. Managing your injuries and your health matters as much as anything that happens in the ring. Stay sharp and recover smart.

A throwback art style carries modern gameplay systems and detail underneath. Retro on the surface, deeper than it looks.

Whether you’re a hardcore fight fan or just love a gritty, underdog story with old-school flavor, Bruisers 2D Boxing brings you the chance to create your own boxing journey.

Alongside the gameplay, Bruisers benefits from a 16-bit-inspired soundtrack, with hours of music lovingly handcrafted by Nick Bassett.
description_short: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal.
